name: DetailDomainsCard
title: Blocks/Detail/DetailDomainsCard
summary: The domains card of a resource settings tab: a borderless data-driven table of the addresses the resource answers on, each with its environment as the row's one medium tag, its deployment policy as text, its certificate as a verified glyph and text, and a row actions menu, over a footer that counts them and adds one. Rendered in the Domains section of a resource’s Settings tab, where an environment-less domain leaves its Environment and Policy cells empty and the count reads domain or domains. Built from `Card`, `DataTable`, `Tag`, `TableCellActions` and `Button`.
